description: This file defines a Go struct for configuring Kubernetes ServicePort objects declaratively, including methods for building instances via method chaining.

classes.name: ServicePortApplyConfiguration
classes.description: A struct for declarative configuration of a Kubernetes ServicePort, with fields for name, protocol, appProtocol, port, targetPort, and nodePort.

methods.name: ServicePort
methods.description: Constructor function that returns a new instance of ServicePortApplyConfiguration.

methods.name: WithName
methods.description: Sets the Name field in the configuration.

methods.name: WithProtocol
methods.description: Sets the Protocol field in the configuration.

methods.name: WithAppProtocol
methods.description: Sets the AppProtocol field in the configuration.

methods.name: WithPort
methods.description: Sets the Port field in the configuration.

methods.name: WithTargetPort
methods.description: Sets the TargetPort field in the configuration.

methods.name: WithNodePort
methods.description: Sets the NodePort field in the configuration.
